fields.default: Two days with the people who talk to customers for a living

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Talks, panels and hands-on workshops for product researchers, designers and PMs. Every session is recorded for ticket holders.

sessions.title: Registration and coffee
sessions.description: Pick up your badge and meet the people who also tag transcripts for a living.

sessions.title: Research that changes the roadmap
sessions.speaker: Priya Raman, Fieldnote
sessions.description: Why most insights die in a slide deck, and three habits of teams whose research actually ships.

sessions.title: Recruiting the customers you never hear from
sessions.speaker: Sofia Alvarez, Brightpath
sessions.description: How Brightpath reached churned and low-usage customers, and what they said that power users never would.

sessions.title: Who owns research when everyone does it?
sessions.speaker: Jonas Becker, Northwind and Amara Osei, Ledgerly
sessions.description: Research leads on guardrails, coaching and keeping quality high when product managers run their own interviews.

sessions.title: Lunch
sessions.description: Tables are grouped by topic, so the conversation can keep going.

sessions.title: From twelve interviews to five themes in a morning
sessions.speaker: Fieldnote research team
sessions.description: Bring your own transcripts or use our sample study. Laptops required, 40 seats.

sessions.title: Writing discussion guides that do not lead
sessions.speaker: Marcus Lee, Northwind
sessions.description: Rewrite real questions from real guides, and learn the five patterns that bias answers.

sessions.title: Five years of continuous discovery
sessions.speaker: Tom Okafor, Ledgerly
sessions.description: What changed when Ledgerly committed to talking to customers every week, and what it cost.
